JATIN SHEWARAMANI 

Content Strategist   ·   Editorial Journalist   ·   Content Creator 

Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  |  +91 93364 65792  |  jatinshewaramani112@gmail.com  |  Portfolio: 
https://astvyastjatin.my.canva.site/ 

 

P R O F E S S I O N A L  S U M M A R Y  

 

 

Results-driven Content Strategist and Editorial Journalist with 6+ years of hands-on experience in social media 
management, content creation, and integrated campaign execution. Journalism-trained with a sharp editorial instinct 
for field research, long-form storytelling, and hyperlocal reporting. Delivered 2M+ organic reach and grew Instagram 
audiences by 20-40% through data-driven content strategies and A/B testing. Proficient in leading CMS platforms 
(WordPress, Contentful), AI-powered content workflows (Sora, Google Veo, Midjourney), and on-camera 
presentation with professional voiceover experience. 
 

C O R E  S K I L L S  

 

 

CMS Platforms: WordPress · Contentful 

Social Media: Instagram · YouTube · Facebook · 
LinkedIn · Hootsuite 

Content Strategy: Editorial planning · Campaign 
execution · SEO Copywriting · Brand voice 

Journalism: Hyperlocal reporting · Feature writing · Field 
research 

Video & On-Camera: Scripting · Shooting · Editing · 
Voiceover · On-camera presentation 

AI & Creative: Sora · Google Veo · Midjourney · Gemini · 
Canva 

Editing Software: Adobe Premiere Pro · DaVinci 
Resolve · Corel Draw 

Paid Campaigns: Meta Ads Manager · Google Ads · A/B 
Testing · ROAS Optimisation 

 

W O R K  E X P E R I E N C E  

 

Editorial Head – Content Strategist  ·  Knocksense Media Services Pvt. Ltd. Aug 2022 – Present 

Content Strategy & Campaign Management 

– Developed platform-specific content strategies across Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook, growing followership 
by 20-40% through audience segmentation, trend analysis, A/B testing, and consistent content calendars. 

– Executed high-reach branded content campaigns delivering 90% audience penetration and measurable CTR 
uplift for partner brands. 

– Ran performance-driven Meta & Google Ads campaigns — managing budgets, audience targeting, creative 
testing, and ROAS reporting. 

– Crafted high-impact taglines, CTAs, and microcopy for campaigns, directly enhancing brand recall and 
conversion rates. 

– Collaborated with cross-functional teams to drive content gamification, UX-led engagement, and editorial 
consistency across all channels. 

Editorial & Journalism 

– Authored hyperlocal news, sports, and feature stories optimised for TAM expansion and audience retention — 
applying rigorous field research and journalistic sourcing standards. 

– Managed content publishing workflows on WordPress, Quintype and Contentful, maintaining editorial 
calendars, SEO metadata, and structured content across multiple verticals. 

– Led editorial planning and calendar management, ensuring timely, accurate, and audience-relevant coverage. 

Video Production & On-Camera 

– Produced viral short-form and long-form video content achieving 2M+ organic reach, leveraging A/B testing 
and platform-specific publishing strategies. 

– Led end-to-end video production — scripting, shooting, and editing — optimising watch time, CTR, and 
audience retention metrics. 

– Emceed large-scale public events (10,000+ attendees) with high-energy on-camera delivery and integrated live 
audience engagement. 

mailto:jatinshewaramani112@gmail.com
https://astvyastjatin.my.canva.site/


Content Lead  ·  EuNext Publications Apr 2021 – Aug 2022 

– Authored in-depth long-form content for the publication vertical, boosting reader engagement through structured, 
research-backed storytelling. 

– Ghostwrote high-quality educational material across subject areas, maintaining factual accuracy, editorial clarity, 
and SEO optimisation. 

– Managed and published content on WordPress — handling post formatting, SEO tagging, and editorial 
scheduling for the publication and media verticals. 

– Scripted and produced videos for the media vertical, applying platform-specific formatting and audience 
retention techniques. 

Content Writer  ·  Vouchers Worldwide Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Sep 2020 – Feb 2021 

– Led end-to-end website content development, establishing core sections (About, T&C, Privacy Policy) and 
improving SEO score by 50%. 

– Created and optimised SEO blogs for multi-country audiences, driving a 75% increase in organic reach and 
strengthening international brand visibility. 

 

E D U C A T I O N  

 

Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Aug 2016 – Mar 2019 

Babu Banarasi Das University, Lucknow  ·  Specialisation: Digital Marketing 

– Team Lead, College Dramatics Team — awarded at IIT and IIM cultural fests, demonstrating leadership, live 
performance, and creative direction. 

 

C E R T I F I C A T I O N S  

 

 

– Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate 

– Google Analytics Individual Qualification (GAIQ) 

– HubSpot Content Marketing Certification 

– HubSpot Social Media Marketing Certification 

P O R T F O L I O  &  W O R K  S A M P L E S  

 

 

– AI Video Portfolio: Sora & Google Veo content samples showcasing AI-powered creation workflows — link.  

– Viral Content: Short-form video achieving 2M+ organic views with zero paid promotion — link. 

– Brand Campaigns: Branded content with documented 90% audience penetration — available on request. 

– Editorial Writing: Published hyperlocal news, sports, and feature articles via Knocksense Media — link. 

 

A D D I T I O N A L  I N F O R M A T I O N  

 

 

Languages: Hindi (Native) · English (Fluent) · Sindhi (Native) · Punjabi (Conversational) 

Creative Interests: Tech & AI · Gaming · News & Journalism · Art · History-driven storytelling 

On-Camera: Professional on-camera presenter and voiceover artist with large-scale event emceeing experience 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AMHsk3qFQLb5e8_dYqfaxDw-qd1E4Snx?usp=drive_link
https://www.instagram.com/reel/DKwRgU4iRoR/?igsh=cm90b3hpdDV6MXZm
https://www.knocksense.com/author/jatin-shewaramani/
